item.text: Реализация уже создана; сейчас проверяю синтаксис и ключевые сценарии API, включая перезапуск и TTL.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'python3 -m py_compile server.py && tmpdir=$(mktemp -d) && data="$tmpdir/data.json" && python3 server.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 0 --data "$data" >"$tmpdir/out" 2>"$tmpdir/err" & pid=$!; for i in $(seq 1 50); do test -s "$tmpdir/out" && break; sleep 0.05; done; line=$(head -n 1 "$tmpdir/out"); echo "$line"; port=${line#LISTENING }; test "$port" != "$line"; python3 - "$port" <<'"'PY'
import http.client, json, sys, time
p=int(sys.argv[1])
def req(method,path,body=None):
    c=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',p,timeout=3)
    headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'} if body is not None else {}
    c.request(method,path,None if body is None else json.dumps(body),headers)
    r=c.getresponse(); raw=r.read(); c.close()
    return r.status, dict(r.getheaders()), (json.loads(raw) if raw else None)
status,h,b=req('GET','/health'); assert status==200 and b=={'status':'ok'} and h['Content-Type']=='application/json'
status,h,b=req('PUT','/v1/kv/hello%20world',{'value':{'x':1}}); assert status==201
status,h,b=req('GET','/v1/kv/hello%20world'); assert status==200 and b=={'key':'hello world','value':{'x':1}}
status,h,b=req('PUT','/v1/kv/ttl',{'value':1,'ttl_seconds':0.1}); assert status==201
time.sleep(.2); status,h,b=req('GET','/v1/kv/ttl'); assert status==404
status,h,b=req('GET','/v1/keys'); assert status==200 and b=={'keys':['hello world']}
status,h,b=req('PUT','/v1/kv/x',{'value':1,'ttl_seconds':0}); assert status==400
status,h,b=req('PUT','/v1/kv/x',[]); assert status==400
status,h,b=req('DELETE','/v1/kv/hello%20world'); assert status==204 and b is None
print('api assertions passed')
PY
kill -TERM \""'$pid"; wait "$pid"; python3 server.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 0 --data "$data" >"$tmpdir/out2" 2>"$tmpdir/err2" & pid2=$!; for i in $(seq 1 50); do test -s "$tmpdir/out2" && break; sleep 0.05; done; port2=$(head -n1 "$tmpdir/out2"); port2=${port2#LISTENING }; python3 - "$port2" <<'"'PY'
import http.client,json,sys
c=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',int(sys.argv[1]),timeout=3); c.request('GET','/v1/keys'); r=c.getresponse(); assert r.status==200 and json.loads(r.read())=={'keys':[]}; c.close(); print('restart assertion passed')
PY
kill -TERM \""'$pid2"; wait "$pid2"; rm -rf "$tmpdir"'
